blind.description: A stylized low-poly cartoon tree featuring a stout, flared brown wood trunk with visible roots that rests directly on the ground. The canopy consists of several rounded, overlapping leafy foliage clumps textured with painted leaf patterns in shades of vibrant green, lime green, and yellow highlights. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and clean, with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a cluster of overlapping, rounded green textured lobes or mounds forming a full foliage canopy, resembling a stylized head of broccoli or clustered leaf masses.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 14 to 15 ft tall) and roughly 10 to 12 ft wide across the foliage canopy.
